location_exception_reason: Portable houses are manufactured products with nationwide applicability; location in title is a seller attribute (where they operate), not a product attribute. Buyers search by specifications (size, insulation, frame material), not origin region. No GI or regional-origin signal present.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') in portable house titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Portable House Manufacturer' leaves a complete, unchanged product definition.
